text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through 
the Twinkle Series with my partner 
Umamusume would begin. The name of the 
girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
I want to get back at everyone who ever 
made fun of me. With these legs and my own 
strength, I'll shut them all up.

text_block_list.name: Narita Taishin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer or not, if you get in my way, 
I'll kick your ass.

And so, our challenge for the Twinkle 
Series with <chrname> began!
